topic: Toys R Us bankruptcy and private equity debt

sources.claim: 2005 LBO by KKR/Bain/Vornado, $6.6B transaction value, $26.75/share, >$5B debt drawn onto Toys R Us
sources.source: SEC Form DEFA14A/8-K filings; Marketplace.org retrospective

sources.claim: ~$5B debt remaining and ~$400M/yr debt service at 2017 bankruptcy filing; ~$464M in fees collected by the PE firms; ~33,000 jobs lost
sources.source: Forbes reporting on Toys R Us bankruptcy
